review_kind: Independent bounded source review of writer, original-input admission, container reader, saved-query replay and execution host
reviewer: foliage_glb_renderer subagent; author of the renderer, not author of the reviewed writer/reader/host files
resolved_during_review: Reader now rejects boolean/float substitutes for JSON integer fields and boolean base-colour factors; the new synthetic cases cover those boundaries.
Fresh inspection binds both actual imported corner NPY files to the recorded Blender receipt SHA256 and byte length before loading them.
Every dependent stage now requires the previous owned-host PASS and exact worker receipt SHA256, rather than only the worker classification.
The natural-empty Job grace is bounded by the original 180-second deadline and cannot produce PASS for an owned process tree settling after it.

source_findings.coordinates_geometry: Writer applies original (x,y,z) to glTF (x,z,-y), a proper determinant+1 rotation. Shared original indices and winding remain unchanged. Independent reader inverses the rotation and compares original F32 position bits, ordered indices and multiplicity exactly.
source_findings.colours_source_ids: Saved F32 linear RGB is serialized directly without fitting, gamma change or byte quantisation. Dense VEC3 F32 COLOR_0 and original I64 vertex/I32 face IDs with original NPY digests are independently checked. Writer bounds make U16 indices safe.
source_findings.container_material: Exactly one embedded core glTF2 triangle primitive, identity node and one OPAQUE double-sided material. No UV, NORMAL, texture, image, sampler, extension or external URI. Unit base factor and exact declared metallic/roughness constants are verified.
source_findings.source_admission: Pinned original admission authenticates the fixed selection, original geometry/material correspondence and qualified prior decision arrays. Writer and independent reader do not derive reference colours from imported Blender data.
source_findings.saved_queries: Reader reuses all 58,951 saved locations and source-spatial samples. Centroid, area-weighted, combined-required, seam-edge and seam-near cohorts preserve original RGB RMSE<=0.02, p95<=0.05, maximum<=0.15 and per-scalar RMSE<=0.02, with actual OPAQUE alpha=1. Inspection applies the same cohorts to actual recorded imported corner values.
source_findings.render_readback: Inspection independently reopens the four recorded 640-square RGBA PNGs and verifies SHA256/bytes, whole-image and silhouette-union RGB gates, alpha>=128 silhouette IoU>=0.999, and writes one private labelled contact sheet. This review deliberately excludes the renderer implementation authored by this reviewer.
source_findings.execution: Four sequential exclusive stages, prior worker/host PASS gates, exact binary GO only after owned Job attachment, process and Job memory limits of 6 GiB, 180-second owned execution limit, 12 GiB available-RAM and 2 GiB destination-free floors, live resource checks, unchanged watched sources and naturally empty Job required. Forced cleanup cannot PASS.
source_findings.exclusions: Python numerical workers install the existing source-pinned guard against model/GPU/renderer imports, subprocess/network execution and writes outside the new private artifact root. Native renderer launch is fixed to Blender 5.2 with factory startup and disabled autoexec; host hides CUDA/HIP/ROCm devices and limits CPU threading. No WSL, neural inference, UV solve, bake or full-asset export is launched by reviewed code.

scope: GO for the exact frozen reviewed sources against the qualification plan. This is source review only; actual export/import/render outcomes and independent visual inspection remain required and are not asserted here.
